**Regulation to analyze:** 10 CFR 73.54 (with RG 5.71 Rev. 1 controls), 10 CFR 73.54
**Why:** Binding, inspected (IP 71130.10) cyber rule for power reactors; RG 5.71 Rev. 1 supplies a NIST SP 800-53/800-82-derived control catalog suited to control-by-control gap analysis. Use 73.110/RG 5.96 for Part 53 plants.

**Applicability check first:** at this size the business is a radioactive and hazardous waste processor. Decide whether 10 CFR 73.54 (with RG 5.71 Rev. 1 controls) applies directly or only through contracts. If it does not apply, analyze the regulation that governs this business, and record the reasoning.
